RPG Life Sciences is leading global trusted pharma brand

RPG Life Sciences, a part of RPG Enterprises, is an integrated pharmaceutical company operating in the domestic and international markets in the Branded Formulations, Global Generics and Synthetic APIs space. The company is a research based, pharmaceutical company, producing a wide range of quality, affordable medicines.

Operations

Business Portfolio

RPG Life Sciences operates through three business verticals – API, Domestic Formulations and International Formulations.

Therapeutic Focus

We have a diverse product portfolio spanning over 10 therapeutic areas including Nephrology, Oncology, Urology, Respiratory, etc.

Facilities

Our Formulations facilities are located at Ankleshwar, Gujarat and Synthetic API facility is located at Navi Mumbai.

Quality

Quality is considered paramount by us during development, manufacture and testing of our products.

Company Awards

Flexible rewards policy and work-life balance programs reflect our emphasis on employees.

Research and Development

Formulation Research & Development forms the most significant pillar of our growth strategy.

Corporate Social Responsibility

Our vision is to drive holistic empowerment of the community around the local vicinity of our plants and society at large.

Environment and Sustainability

Environment, Health and Safety has been one of our key areas where there has been a constant endeavor to excel.
